sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 33; Internal Quality Checks row 33 annotation)
evidence:
Scope: all 55 criteria in the frozen task (.qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r6/task): gates/render 1, gates/constraints 1, scored/functional 43, scored/polish 5, scored/visual 5 (counted via [[criterion]] grep). Workbook Quality Checks row 33 and Internal Quality Checks row 33 read via openpyxl read_only (internal note, Mukesh: multiple verifiers combined in one flow are acceptable); skill references/quality-checks.md #33 (Defect: enumerates several requirements then waives most, leaving two targets) and SKILL.md known false positive (one criterion covering a whole flow is not a defect for checks 26/28/33). Template tests/scored/functional/{prompt.md,judge.toml} read for the house criterion shape. REVIEW_POLICY.md read.

Method: for every criterion, compared the positive bar with its explicit 'Fails if' list and the appended 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold', and inspected every optional/waiver/alternative clause. Instances found and assessed:
1. hro_gate_render (gates/render/judge.toml:23) 'a refusal message is welcome but not required' - single explicit optional; bar = stays signed out + valid sign-in. Consistent.
2. hro_job_open (scored/functional/judge.toml:29) team/manager/places 'shown wherever the app shows job details or are evidenced by behaviour' - evidence-route flexibility; fail list 'a shown value is wrong' matches. Consistent.
3. hro_add_candidate (:38) '(and the email wherever the app shows card details)' - same pattern, consistent.
4. hro_move_one_stage (:56), hro_reject_hired (:92), hro_mgr_other_job (:164) 'hiding it is optional' - concerns UI presentation only; server refusal still required; fail lists match. Consistent.
5. hro_arrive_bottom (:65) pass names the A/B scenario, fail generalises 'lands anywhere but the bottom when not dropped at a place' - same bar, consistent.
6. hro_reject_reason (:83) reason/stage readable 'on the card, its details, its reopen control or its Activity line' - location alternatives, single bar.
7. hro_refused_put_back (:137) 'A UI that refuses before the card moves, with the reason shown and focus on that card, also passes' - alternative path still demands the same legs (real place, reason, focus). Consistent.
8. hro_observer_readonly (:173), hro_undo_once (:254) 'Whether ... controls / the undo control is hidden is the app's choice' - presentation only; replay refusal is the bar.
9. hro_activity (:263) '(notes and messages are not recorded...; one line naming every card of a multi-card move with its stages also satisfies that move)' - scope clarification and format alternative, not a waiver; fail list matches pass legs (missing line, unattributed, out of order, filter).
10. hro_candidate_private (:389) board/Activity replays 'refused or answered with only that candidate's own data' - two acceptable outcomes of one isolation bar; fail 'any of that data or existence leaks' consistent.
11. hro_thread_access (:362) 'not listed, or refused' / 'no send control, or a send is refused' - alternatives of one bar.
12. hro_candidate_linked (:398) 'rows run on his seeded conversation instead are not reduced for it' - ownership note matching functional prompt.md:39 fallback; not a waiver of this row's bar.
13. hro_pol_live_thread (scored/polish/judge.toml:32) 'This row owns the draft and focus; where the view goes while reading earlier messages is graded in Functional' - still requires 'view stays at the newest message' with matching fail clause; the deferral covers only the scrolled-up case (owned by hro_unread_scrolled_up). Consistent.
14. hro_pol_failed_send (:50) abort-request or setOffline - method alternatives; bundles a note-draft-on-reload leg, which is a conjunctive flow bundle (skill known false positive), not two targets.
15. hro_pol_session_resume (:59) 'unless the sign-in prompt has already appeared on its own (that also passes)' - alternative trigger, same outcome bar.
16. hro_pol_live_board (scored/polish/judge.toml:23) 'if neither scrolls at this viewport, add cards until one does, or record that no scroll exists and judge the other legs' - the only judge-discretion waiver found: the 'or' lets the judge either create scroll or skip the scroll leg, so the scroll-not-reset leg has two possible targets. It waives one of five legs (not most), and only when no scroll exists, in which case there is no offset to reset; the closing 'Fails if any condition stated above does not hold' plus 'Fails if ... resets scroll' stay coherent. Recorded as a P3 Note, not a Fail.
17. Visual likert rows (scored/visual/judge.toml:24-89) each give one dimension with five anchors; no enumerate-and-waive pattern. Gate hro_gate_shared (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23) has one conjunctive bar with explicit exclusions ('Do not grade stage rules, conversations or live updates here') that scope rather than waive.
Functional prompt.md:13/19/23 cross-row ownership statements ('deducted only in hro_activity_refusals', 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row') are consistent with the criteria that delegate (hro_arrive_bottom -> hro_bulk_move, hro_interview_full -> hro_bulk_places/hro_undo_full, hro_drafts -> hro_msg_compose, hro_candidate_view -> hro_candidate_private/hro_msg_exchange). No criterion lists several requirements and then waives most of them.

Adversarial probes: (a) broken app that could pass: an app that resets scroll on live update but whose board/page does not scroll at the judge viewport - if the judge picks 'record no scroll', the scroll leg is skipped; but with no scrollable area nothing can be reset, so no real defect is credited, and the other legs (details open, note text exact, focus, append) still gate. (b) conforming alternative that could fail: an app that shows team/manager/places nowhere but enforces them - covered by 'evidenced by behaviour' in hro_job_open; an app that hides skip/hired-reject controls - covered by 'hiding it is optional' plus replay. No dual-target counterexample with scoring impact found.
Limitations: source-level reading of the frozen criterion text only; no judge run was needed or consulted for this wording row. raw-evidence-index.json exists but was not relied on; no runtime claim is made.
counterexample: Only judge-discretion clause found: hro_pol_live_board 'add cards until one does, or record that no scroll exists and judge the other legs' lets two judges pick different targets for the scroll leg. No credible mis-grade results because with no scrollable area nothing can be reset; it waives one leg conditionally, not most legs, so it is not a row-33 defect.
suggested_fix: Optional tidy: in hro_pol_live_board write 'if neither scrolls, add cards until one does; only if it still cannot scroll, record that and judge the other legs', removing the judge's choice.
